_help: Rules for the character builder. Change the numbers when the rules change.

concept.title: Concept
concept.intro: Who is your character? Give them a name and a short concept. A portrait is optional.

ambition.title: Ambition
ambition.intro: The ambition is the central driving force of your character. Ideally it can be summed up in one word. Pick an example or write your own.

ancestry.title: Ancestry
ancestry.intro: Your ancestry sets your wounds, traits and starting talents.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: All skills start at 1. Distribute 15 points, a skill can go up to 5. You may lower one skill to 0 to gain an extra point.

traits.title: Traits
traits.intro: Choose 3 traits that describe both positive and negative sides of your character. Traits can give boons or flaws on checks.

talents.title: Talents
talents.intro: Choose 5 talents. Ancestry talents are granted automatically and don't count. Talents whose prerequisites you don't meet are locked.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.intro: Your finished character. Print it, save it as a file or keep editing – it is stored in this browser automatically.
